cells.text: "Payment should be retried where possible" (`requirements.md:13`): no count and no timing. Rewrite: "If the payment gateway returns `<which errors>`, the system shall retry up to `<N>` times, `<T>` s apart." The documents give no values, so the owner fills the placeholders
"Discounts never exceed 20%" (`requirements.md:19`) does not say what happens above the cap. Rewrite: "When the total discount is above 20%, the system shall cap it at 20%."
`design.md:88` (DEC-11) allows 25%, so there are two expected results. Keep 20% or 25%, then edit the other document; this fixes DEC-11 too (I-7)

"Sessions must expire in a reasonable time" (`requirements.md:23`): no limit. Rewrite: "When a session has been idle for `<T>` min, the system shall expire it." The documents give no limit, so the owner fills `<T>`

"Concession card holders get 10% off" (`requirements.md:25`): does not say how it combines with other discounts. Rewrite: "When a concession card holder gets a quote, the system shall apply 10% off `<before or after>` the other discounts, within the discount cap."

"Refund is pro rata minus a $50 fee" (`requirements.md:27`): pro rata by day or by month gives two refunds. Rewrite: "When a policy is cancelled, the system shall refund the premium pro rata by `<day or month>`, minus a $50 fee."
`design.md:88` conflicts with the 20% cap in REQ-08 and does not say which wins. Fixed by the same edit as REQ-08 (I-3)

`design.md:101` says nothing about a refund the gateway rejects or does not answer. Rewrite: "If the gateway does not confirm a refund, the policy stays cancelled and the refund is retried up to `<N>` times, then `<next step>`." The documents give no values, so the owner fills the placeholders
